• Apex Jobs panel is empty: no framework batches (class names starting with CR_) ran in the last 24 hours. That can be intentional (no nightly cron, no manual runs) or a sign the nightly cron isn't scheduled — check the Scheduled Jobs panel below.
  • Permission denied scheduling the nightly: you need the Run_Custom_Reporting_ETL custom permission. Ask your Salesforce admin to grant it via a permission set.
  • Recent Errors panel always empty: either the framework hasn't logged any failures lately (good!) or the running user can't see Dashboard_Run__c / Dashboard_Component_Run__c records due to sharing rules. Check object access.
  • ExtendedStatus is blank on a failed job: some failure modes (governor-limit aborts mid-batch) don't populate ExtendedStatus. Open the job in Setup → Apex Jobs to see the platform-level message, or enable a debug log for the batch class.
  • Page won't load (blank panels): the running user's profile lacks read access to AsyncApexJob or CronTrigger. Both require View Setup and Configuration, Author Apex, or Modify All Data.
